Velo Vixens/CBC Tuesday Night Hills Ride

Chattanooga, TN · Red Bank · Road

No-dropWomen / trans / femme

Velo Vixens/CBC Tuesday Night Hills Ride is a road group ride in Chattanooga, TN. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Across from the Red Bank playground and tennis courts. About 12 miles, no-drop hill repeats.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop hill repeats. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @chattanoogabicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Velo Vixens/CBC Tuesday Night Hills Ride group ride

A weekly hill session co-led by the women's group Velo Vixens and the bike club. It is not women-only. About 12 miles with more than 100 feet of climbing per mile. First riders up each hill go back to the last rider and climb again, so nobody is dropped. Front and rear lights are advised.
